DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 田んぼの東側を見回ってきましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you checked the east side of the rice field?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、端の土が崩れて、細い水が隣の溝へ流れています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 畦の土の崩れと隣の溝への漏水を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The soil at the edge has collapsed, and a thin stream of water is running into the neighboring ditch.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the collapsed soil on the embankment and the water leaking into the neighboring ditch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 水が出ている場所には、まだ近づいていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: You haven't gone close to where the water is coming out yet, have you?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 畦が柔らかかったので手前で止まりました。場所は赤い杭の二メートル先です。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 柔らかい畦に入らなかったことと赤い杭からの位置を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The embankment was soft, so I stopped before reaching it. The spot is two meters beyond the red stake.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you did not step onto the soft embankment and give the location relative to the red stake. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 位置が分かりました。私が確認するまで、その畦には乗らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I understand where it is. Please don't step onto that embankment until I've checked it.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 水を止めようと思いましたが、水口は触らずに待ったほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自己判断で水口を操作せず待つべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was thinking of stopping the water, but should I wait without touching the water inlet?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you should wait without operating the water inlet on your own judgment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのままにしてください。まず安全な道から状態を見て、対応を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please leave it as it is. I'll first look at its condition from a safe path, then decide what to do.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 別の人が東側へ向かっています。離れた所から声をかけて止めますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 東側へ向かう作業者を離れた場所から呼び止めると申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Someone else is heading toward the east side. I'll call out from a distance and stop them.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Offer to call out from a distance to stop the worker heading east. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お願いします。止まってもらったら、二人とも資材置き場の前で待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. Once they've stopped, both of you should wait in front of the materials storage area.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 東側へ行かないよう伝えて、資材置き場で次の指示を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 東側への立入りを止め資材置き場で指示を待つと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tell them not to go to the east side, and we'll wait at the materials storage area for further instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will stop access to the east side and wait at the materials storage area for instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 報告してくれて助かりました。足元に気をつけて戻ってください、お疲れさまです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for reporting it; that was helpful. Watch your footing on the way back. Thank you for your work.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どうなさいましたか。ホームの端から少し下がってお話しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: What happened? Please step back a little from the platform edge before you tell me.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 手袋が線路に落ちました。ベンチで荷物を出したときに飛んでしまったんです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手袋が荷物を出した際に線路へ落ちたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My glove fell onto the tracks. It flew off when I was taking things out of my bag on the bench.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your glove fell onto the tracks while you were taking things out of your bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お客様は線路へ降りないでください。何色の手袋ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please don't go down onto the tracks yourself. What color is the glove?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 茶色で、親指のところに白い糸が見えます。あの柱の前に落ちています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 茶色の手袋の特徴と柱の前という落下位置を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's brown, with some white thread showing near the thumb. It's fallen in front of that pillar.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the brown glove and say it fell in front of the pillar. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認できました。列車の運行状況を確認して、係員が対応します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I can see it. Staff will handle it after checking the train operations.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 乗る列車があと十分で来ますが、回収を待つと乗り遅れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 十分後の列車に乗る予定と回収を待つ影響を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: The train I plan to take arrives in ten minutes. Will I miss it if I wait for the glove to be retrieved?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you plan to take a train in ten minutes and ask how waiting for retrieval would affect that. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 回収時刻はまだお約束できません。お急ぎなら、後で受け取る方法も相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can't promise a retrieval time yet. If you're in a hurry, we can also discuss collecting it later.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は戻ってこられないので、連絡先を残して列車に乗りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 当日戻れないため連絡先を残して乗車したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can't come back today, so I'd like to leave my contact details and get on the train.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you cannot return today and would like to leave contact details and board the train. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では窓口でお名前と連絡先をお預かりします。見つかった品の受取り方もそこで確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then we'll take your name and contact details at the counter. Let's also check there how you can collect the recovered item.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 線路には近づかず、窓口で連絡先を伝えてから乗車します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 線路へ近づかず窓口で連絡先を伝えて乗ると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't go near the tracks. I'll give my contact details at the counter before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will stay away from the tracks and give your contact details at the counter before boarding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ホームでは係員の案内に従ってくださいね。お気をつけていってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please follow the staff's guidance on the platform. Have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 大根を切ったら、鍋に入れる前に見せてくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: When you've cut the daikon, please show me before putting it in the pot.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 最初の三枚を薄く切り過ぎました。残りも同じ厚さにするべきですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 薄く切った大根三枚に残りの厚さを合わせるべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I cut the first three slices too thin. Should I make the rest the same thickness?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the rest of the daikon should match the three thin slices. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 残りは見本の厚さで切りましょう。薄い三枚は、別のお皿に置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's cut the rest to match the sample. Please put the three thin slices on a separate plate.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 見本は一センチくらいですね。包丁を持つ前に幅を見比べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 見本が約一センチであると確かめ包丁を持つ前に比べると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The sample is about one centimeter thick, right? I'll compare the widths before picking up the knife.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that the sample is about one centimeter thick and say you will compare before picking up the knife. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、その厚さです。厚い大根から煮て、薄いものは後から入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, that thickness. We'll simmer the thick daikon first and add the thin slices later.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 薄いものを後に入れるのは、煮崩れを防ぐためですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 薄い大根を後から煮る理由が煮崩れ防止か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Is adding the thin slices later to keep them from falling apart as they cook?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check whether thin daikon is added later to prevent it from falling apart. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そうです。鍋に入れるタイミングは私が声をかけますから、今は切る作業に集中しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's right. I'll tell you when to put them into the pot, so let's focus on cutting for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 切り終わったら包丁を置いて、二つのお皿を作業台に残しておけばいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 切った後に包丁を置き二つの皿を作業台に残す段取りを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Once I've finished cutting, I should put the knife down and leave both plates on the workbench, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the steps of putting down the knife and leaving both plates on the workbench after cutting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ええ、包丁は刃を人に向けないように置いてください。お皿は鍋の横へ運ばなくて大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please set the knife down with the blade pointing away from people. You don't need to carry the plates over beside the pot.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 厚さを分けて切り終えたら、包丁を安全に置いて先生を呼びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 厚さ別に切り終え包丁を安全に置いて講師を呼ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: When I've finished cutting and separating the thicknesses, I'll put the knife down safely and call you.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will finish cutting by thickness, put the knife down safely, and call the instructor. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その進め方で大丈夫です。私は隣の台へ戻りますね、また後ほど。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: That approach is fine. I'll go back to the next workbench. See you in a little while.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内所へようこそ。何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome to the information desk. Can I help you with something?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人に送ったメッセージが届きません。北入口で待つ約束ですが、そこが混んでいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通信が届かず北入口での待合せが混雑していると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The message I sent my friend isn't getting through. We agreed to meet at the north entrance, but it's crowded there.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help because your message will not go through and the north-entrance meeting point is crowded. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 北入口の通路では立ち止まらないようご案内しています。お友達とは何時の約束ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We're asking people not to stop in the north-entrance passageway. What time are you meeting your friend?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 六時半です。今から場所を変えても友人に伝わらないかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 六時半の約束で場所変更を友人に知らせられない懸念を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Six thirty. If I change the meeting place now, I might not be able to let my friend know.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the six-thirty meeting time and your concern that you cannot tell your friend about a change of location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では入口を塞がない待機場所を案内図で見ましょう。北入口から見える旗の脇に空きがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let's look at the map for somewhere to wait without blocking the entrance. There's space beside the flag visible from the north entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: あの青い旗ですね。そこから入口の人を見て待ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 青い旗の脇から入口を見ながら待てるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: You mean that blue flag? May I wait there while watching the people at the entrance?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check whether you can wait beside the blue flag while watching the entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通路の外側なら待てます。押し合いが起きるようなら、待たずにこちらへ戻ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: You may wait outside the passageway. If people start pushing, don't stay there; please come back here.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人が案内所へ来た場合に備えて、私が青い旗の脇にいると伝えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人が案内所へ来た場合の伝言を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: If my friend comes to the information desk, could you tell them I'm beside the blue flag?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask staff to pass on a message if your friend comes to the information desk. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 個別の伝言をお預かりする窓口ではないんです。送れるようになった時に、目印を具体的に連絡してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: This desk doesn't take personal messages. When you can send messages again, please describe the landmark clearly to your friend.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 伝言は頼まず、青い旗の脇へ移動して通信が戻ったら目印を送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 伝言を預けず青い旗を目印に通信回復後に連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't leave a message with you. I'll move beside the blue flag and send my friend the landmark once the connection returns.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not leave a message with the desk and will send the blue-flag landmark once service returns. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 混雑に気をつけてお待ちください。よい時間をお過ごしくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please be careful of the crowds while you wait. Have a good time.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: そのかごの持ち手が外れてしまったんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: The handle has come off that basket, I see.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 本体はまだ使えるので、持ち手だけ交換できるか見ていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本体を使い続けるため買い物かごの持ち手だけの交換を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The basket itself is still usable, so I'd like you to check whether just the handle can be replaced.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about replacing only the shopping basket's handle so you can keep using the basket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 取付け部分も拝見します。片方の留め具が欠けていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me look at the attachment points too. One of the fasteners is chipped.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 持ち手を買うだけでは直らないということですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持ち手だけ購入しても修理できないのか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Does that mean buying just a handle wouldn't fix it?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check whether buying only the handle would be insufficient for the repair. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 留め具も必要です。このかごに合う部品があるか、寸法を測って確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: It needs a fastener too. I'll measure it to check whether there are parts that fit this basket.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日はかごを使いたいので、合う部品がなければ修理を急がず持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 合う部品がなければ修理を急がず当日持ち帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to use the basket today, so if there aren't matching parts, I'll take it home without rushing the repair.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will take the basket home today without rushing a repair if matching parts are unavailable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この部品は穴の間隔が合いません。無理に取り付けると本体を傷めますから、注文の可否を調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The holes on this part are spaced differently. Forcing it on would damage the basket, so I'll check whether we can order the right parts.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 注文できた場合の部品代と、取付けの費用を分けて教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 注文可能な場合の部品代と取付け費用を分けて尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: If they can be ordered, please tell me the parts cost and the fitting charge separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask separately about parts and fitting costs if ordering is possible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: メーカーへの確認が必要です。金額が分かってから、お客様に注文するか決めていただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll need to check with the manufacturer. Once we know the price, you can decide whether to order.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見積りの連絡を待って判断します。今日は壊れた持ち手で重い物を運ばないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 見積り後に注文を判断し壊れた持ち手で重い物を運ばないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll decide after hearing the quote. Today I'll avoid carrying heavy things by the broken handle.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will decide on ordering after the quote and avoid carrying heavy items with the broken handle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: かごはこの袋に入れてお返ししますね。またご連絡いたします、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll put the basket in this bag and return it to you. We'll contact you again. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらが、通信プランを変えた場合の見積りです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Here is the estimate for changing your mobile plan.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 通信料は下がっていますが、合計があまり変わりません。この下の行は何の費用ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通信料が下がっても合計が変わらない見積りの項目を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The service charge is lower, but the total hardly changes. What is this line underneath for?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about an estimate item because the total barely changes despite the lower service charge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 端末の分割代金です。通信料とは別の欄に記載されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: That's the installment payment for the handset. It's listed separately from the service charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今の電話を使い続けても、この端末代は残るという理解で合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今の電話を使い続けても端末分割代金が残る理解を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Am I right that these handset payments remain even if I keep using my current phone?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check your understanding that handset installments remain even while you continue using your current phone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見積りには残額が含まれています。契約の支払回数を一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The estimate includes the remaining balance. Let's check the number of payments in your contract together.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 回数の欄が二つあります。支払済みと残りの回数はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 支払済みと残りの回数の欄を区別して尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: There are two fields for the number of payments. Which shows those already paid, and which shows those remaining?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask which fields show paid and remaining installments. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 左が支払済み、右が残りです。こちらの契約内容では、右の回数分が残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The left is the number paid, and the right is the number remaining. Under this contract, the number on the right is still due.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では通信料だけを比べたいので、端末代と追加サービスを除いた額に印を付けてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 端末代と追加サービスを除いた通信料に印を付けるよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'd like to compare just the service charges. Could you mark the amount excluding the handset and extra services?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask them to mark the service charge excluding handset payments and additional services. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この欄が通信料です。ただし割引の適用条件もあるので、条件の説明も添えておきますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: This field is the service charge. There are conditions for the discounts, though, so I'll include an explanation of those too.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 印の付いた通信料と割引条件を家で見直します。今日はプラン変更を申し込まずに帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通信料と割引条件を持ち帰り当日は変更を申し込まないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll review the marked service charge and discount conditions at home. I won't apply to change my plan today.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will take the service charge and discount conditions home and will not apply for a change today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 見積りをお持ちください。ご検討ありがとうございました、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take the estimate with you. Thank you for considering it. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの書類を見ながら、相談したい点を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll ask what you'd like advice about while looking at the documents you brought.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 申告の控えが二枚あります。どちらを今回の相談に使えばいいか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二枚の申告控えのどちらを相談に使うべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have two copies of tax returns. I don't know which to use for today's consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask which of two tax return copies you should use for the consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず、相談したいのはいつの収入についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, which year's income do you want to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 去年の収入です。一枚は今年出したものですが、もう一枚は一昨年の分かもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 相談対象が去年の収入で別の控えは一昨年の可能性があると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Last year's income. One was submitted this year, but the other may be for the year before last.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your question concerns last year's income and the other copy may be for the year before last. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 提出した日と対象の年は違うことがあります。用紙の上に書かれた「年分」を見てみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The submission date and the year covered can be different. Let's check the tax year written at the top of the form.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 上の年分が違っています。去年に当たる方だけを相談用に出せばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 年分が去年に当たる控えを相談用に出せばよいか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: The years at the top are different. Should I provide just the one covering last year for the consultation?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check whether you should submit the copy covering last year for the consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まずはその控えを拝見します。前の年の分も、別の用紙だと分かるように保管しておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll look at that copy first. Please keep the earlier year's copy in a way that makes it clear it's a separate document.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 去年の控えの収入額と、会社の書類の金額が違います。次はその違いを相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 去年の控えと会社の書類の収入額の違いを相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: The income amount on last year's copy differs from the amount on the company's document. That's what I'd like to discuss next.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to discuss the difference in income amounts between last year's return copy and the company document. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では会社の書類も確認します。数字だけで判断せず、どの欄の金額かを確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then we'll check the company document too. Let's check which fields the amounts come from, rather than judging from the numbers alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 会社の書類は家にあるので、年分ごとに書類をまとめてから相談し直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会社の書類を年分ごとにまとめて再相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: The company's document is at home, so I'll organize the documents by tax year and come back for another consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will organize the company documents by tax year and consult again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 再相談の方法は受付でご確認ください。今日はありがとうございました、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-MASUDA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please ask reception how to arrange another consultation. Thank you for coming today. Take care.

DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの地図を、こちらの案内図と見比べていらっしゃるのですか。
DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you comparing your map with this information map?

DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 宿でもらった地図では川沿いの道が続いていますが、こちらは途中で線が切れています。どちらを頼りに歩けばいいですか。
DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 宿の地図と案内図で川沿いの道の表示が異なると伝え、使う地図を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-02.translation: The map from my lodging shows the riverside path continuing, but the line stops partway on this one. Which map should I follow?
DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the lodging map and information map show the riverside path differently and ask which to use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 古い地図かもしれませんね。今日はどちらへ向かわれますか。
DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-03.translation: It might be an old map. Where would you like to go today?

DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 古い家並みを見ながら駅へ戻りたいです。川沿いを通らなくても構いません。
DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家並みを見て駅へ戻る希望と、川沿いを避けてもよい条件を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to return to the station while looking at the old houses. I don't mind avoiding the riverside.
DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to see the old houses and return to the station and can avoid the riverside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 橋を渡って通りへ出る経路がありますが、この地図には橋の工事情報が載っていません。出発前に通れるか確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-05.translation: There's a route across the bridge to the street, but this map doesn't show bridge construction information. Let's check whether you can cross before you leave.

DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 橋が使えないと遠回りになるので、その場合の道も地図に印を付けてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 橋を通れない場合に備え、迂回路を地図に記してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-06.translation: If the bridge is closed, it'll be a detour. Could you mark the alternative route on the map too?
DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask them to mark a detour on the map in case the bridge cannot be crossed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、こちらの交差点を回る経路を点線で示します。駅へ戻る時刻は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, I'll mark the route around this intersection with a dotted line. Do you have a set time to return to the station?

DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二時半には駅に着きたいです。途中の見学を省いて、まず帰り道を押さえます。
DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 駅へ着く期限を伝え、見学より帰りの経路の確認を優先する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to arrive at the station by two thirty. I'll skip sightseeing along the way and establish the return route first.
DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give your station arrival deadline and prioritize checking the way back over sightseeing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それなら、橋の状況を確認したあとで、歩く範囲を決めるのがよさそうです。宿の地図と区別できるよう、こちらに今日の日付を書きますね。
DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then it would be best to decide how far to walk after checking the bridge conditions. I'll write today's date on this map so you can distinguish it from the lodging's map.

DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 助かります。日付のある地図を使い、橋が通れなければ点線の道へ回ります。
DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 日付のある地図を使い、通行できなければ点線の道を選ぶと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you, that helps. I'll use the dated map, and if the bridge is impassable, I'll take the dotted route.
DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will use the dated map and take the dotted route if the bridge cannot be crossed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二枚を取り違えないようにお持ちください。どうぞお気をつけて、いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-SMN-ODA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please keep the two maps without mixing them up. Have a safe trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの台の道具は体験用です。ケースの中のものとは別に展示しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: The tools on this table are for hands-on use. They're displayed separately from the items in the case.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同じ形なので、どちらも昔の道具だと思いました。台の上は複製ということですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ形の展示物を昔の道具と考えた理由を述べ、台の物が複製か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: They have the same shape, so I thought both were old tools. Are the ones on the table replicas?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain why you thought similarly shaped exhibits were old tools and ask whether those on the table are replicas. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい、持ち方を試せるように作った複製です。ケースには、地域で使われていた資料を収めています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes, they're replicas made so you can try holding them. The case contains historical items used in this region.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 複製なら手に取ってよいのですね。持つ前に、壊れやすい部分を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 複製に触れる前に、破損を避ける持ち方を教えてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I can pick up the replicas. Before I do, could you tell me which parts break easily?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask how to hold the replica without damaging it before touching it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 細い柄に力をかけず、太い部分を両手で支えてください。私が持っているこちらで見せますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Don't put force on the thin handle. Support the thick part with both hands. I'll show you using the one I'm holding.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この向きで支えればいいですか。思ったより重くて、片手では持ちにくいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 両手で支える向きを確かめ、道具の重さへの感想を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Should I support it in this direction? It's heavier than I expected and hard to hold with one hand.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the direction for supporting it with both hands and comment on the tool's weight. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その支え方で結構です。重さも作業の負担を考える手がかりになりますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's the right way to support it. The weight also gives us a clue about how demanding the work was.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 説明札の「運搬」は、材料を別の場所へ運ぶという意味ですか。実際の使い道を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 説明札の運搬という語の意味と道具の用途を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Does ‘transport’ on the label mean carrying materials somewhere else? I'd like to know what it was actually used for.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about the meaning of ‘transport’ on the label and what the tool was used for. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、物を運ぶ作業を指します。この展示図で、道具を使う場面と合わせて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, it means the work of moving things. I'll explain using this exhibit diagram alongside a scene of the tool in use.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 用途が分かりました。体験用の道具を元の台へ戻してから、ケースの資料を見比べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 体験用を台へ戻し、ケースの資料と比べる順序を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand its purpose now. I'll put the hands-on tool back on the original table before comparing it with the items in the case.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will return the hands-on tool to the table before comparing it with the case items. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 向きもそろえて戻していただき、ありがとうございます。引き続き、ごゆっくりご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for returning it facing the right way too. Please continue looking around at your leisure.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 歩き始める前に、靴の状態を確かめていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you checking your footwear before you start walking?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ここへ来る途中の水たまりで、靴下まで濡れました。このまま山道へ入ってよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 水たまりで靴下まで濡れた状況を伝え、そのまま山道へ進むか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I stepped in a puddle on the way here, and even my socks got wet. I'm unsure whether I should go onto the mountain trail like this.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that a puddle soaked even your socks and ask whether to continue onto the mountain trail. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 靴の中が濡れたままでは足の具合も悪くなりやすいですね。替えの靴下や靴はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: If the inside of your shoes stays wet, your feet can easily become uncomfortable. Do you have spare socks or shoes?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 替えは持っていません。短い道なら行けると思いましたが、滑るのも心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 替えの履物がないと答え、短い道でも滑る不安を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't brought any spares. I thought I could manage a short route, but I'm also worried about slipping.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have no spare footwear and are concerned about slipping even on a short route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 距離が短くても、足元の問題は残ります。今日は入山せず、まず濡れた物を替えられる場所へ戻ることをお勧めします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Even on a short route, the problem with your footwear remains. I recommend not entering the mountain today and first returning somewhere you can change the wet items.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 山歩きはやめます。連れが先に道の入り口へ行ったので、戻ってもらうよう連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 入山を見送り、先に行った同行者へ戻るよう連絡すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll give up the mountain walk. My companion has gone ahead to the trail entrance, so I'll contact them to come back.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide not to enter the mountain and to ask the companion who went ahead to return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まだ近くにいるなら、待つ場所も伝えてください。こちらで一緒に待ちますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: If they're still nearby, tell them where you'll wait too. Would you like to wait together here?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 小屋の前で待つと伝えました。車へ戻る道は、来た舗装道路でいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 小屋の前で待つと同行者へ伝え、車への帰路を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've told them I'll wait in front of the hut. Is the paved road we came along the right way back to the car?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell your companion you will wait in front of the hut and check the way back to the car. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 来た道を戻る予定なのですね。途中で歩きにくくなったら無理をせず、近くの係員に声をかけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: You're planning to return the way you came, then. If walking gets difficult along the way, don't push yourself; ask a nearby staff member for help.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 舗装道路を連れと戻り、次は替えの靴下も用意します。今日は予定を変えておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 舗装道路を同行者と戻り、次回は替えを準備すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll go back along the paved road with my companion and bring spare socks next time. I'll change today's plans.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will return along the paved road with your companion and prepare spares next time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お連れの方が戻ってこられましたね。足元に気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your companion has come back now. Please watch your footing on the way home.
